strong_form.boundary: psi=0 at r=0; for dipole psi=C*r^2/rho^3, axial alpha=3*|z-zc|/rho^2 and outer-r alpha=3*r/rho^2-2/r in d_n(psi)+alpha*psi=0

weak_form.space: V=H1(Omega), zero trace at r=0, with outer Robin boundary term
weak_form.equation: integral_Omega (nu/r)*grad(psi).grad(v) dr dz = integral_Omega (J_free_phi+J_bound_phi)*v dr dz + integral_Omega G.grad(v) dr dz
weak_form.pm_authority: Use recoil-remanence G or equivalent bound current J_b=curl(M), never both.

discrete_form.matrix: symmetric interior operator with dipole-Robin elimination; the radial logarithmic coefficient can be negative near rectangular corners, so positivity is not assumed and is checked numerically by small-grid minimum-eigenvalue, converged-PCG and positive magnetic-energy evidence
discrete_form.source: separately typed J_free_phi and mu_r-corrected PM J_bound_phi minus the exact face-flux divergence adjoint to the operator gradient
discrete_form.cut_cell_measure: analytic rectangular subsegments and exact line/polygon clipping for linear tapered boundaries; series resistance is integrated along each face-normal connection
discrete_form.sheet_moments: tensor-product linear deposition preserves sheet total and first r/z moments exactly

interface_conditions.pm_bound_current: K_bound_phi=(M cross n)_phi is constitutive/source data, never K_free
interface_conditions.harmonic_face_rationale: constant normal flux requires integrating 1/a with a=nu/r; arithmetic cut-cell averaging is not a valid series transmissibility

analytical_checks: Uniform nu multiplies the equation by mu and exactly recovers the accepted L1a operator -div((1/r)grad(psi))=mu*J_phi.
Reversing every Br polarity reverses psi, Br and Bz by linearity.
For zero free surface current, normal B and tangential H remain continuous; a recoil remanence jump is carried only by H=nu(B-Br).
For uniform axial M=Br/(mu0*mu_r), curl(M)=0 in the magnet interior and K_bound_phi=M_z*n_r on radial faces with opposite inner/outer signs.
Reviewer off-face oracle: an arithmetic coefficient 67.11 corresponds to exact series coefficient 3.883 for the declared subsegment contrast/fraction.

publication_gates.open_boundary: Exactly the required two successive >=1.5 strictly nested padding expansions, base padding >=3 characteristic lengths, every boundary/peak <=1e-3, and successive fixed physical QoI change <=1e-3.
publication_gates.mesh: Interpolated fixed stage-centre QoI mesh and grid-alignment changes <=1e-2; cellwise and sampled-axis extrema are screening-only.
publication_gates.resolution: Every PDE-active material feature requires at least 12 effective cells across radial and axial extents before qualification.
publication_gates.algebraic: Fresh true residual <=1e-8 and converged status.
publication_gates.source: Exact analytical weak actions for basis gradients/values and authoritative raster/source counts; relative bias <=1e-3 when absolute bias exceeds 1e-8 A, and represented totals <=1e-12.
publication_gates.model_form: Fine-grid recoil/equivalent fixed and bore-averaged QoI discrepancy <=2e-2; the discrepancy trend is also reported.
publication_gates.status: Each publication gate is PASS, FAIL, or NOT_EVALUATED with a measured value, threshold, and diagnostic status. Reduced-resource measurements force every gate to NOT_EVALUATED; deterministic replay under the exact implementation revision rejects forged PASS.

claim_boundary: Hypothetical linear-material design simulation, not a validated hardware prediction.
